notes: Recorded under the owner's AFK mandate, extended by the ruling of 2026-09-06 which directs continuation through the ranked remainder after the replay-store seam. Item 2 of that remainder is the shared Redis/etcd stores, measured by the #824 census at 1 of 5 files owned and named there as the mechanisms ASM-0040 and ASM-0041 name. Recorded by the implementing agent as routine owner-review maintenance, not as a transcription of a ruling naming this fingerprint. TWO UNITS AND TWO THEOREMS, NEVER ONE UNION: two mechanisms, two premises, two feature lanes, and THM-0092's own scope already insists that the two are NOT equally strong and that its claim does not level them. A single unit spanning both would also require both features at once, which ADR-MCPRE-061 records as the shape invisible to every single-feature lane. THE PREMISE AND THE THEOREM ANSWER DIFFERENT QUESTIONS and the registration keeps them apart. ASM-0040 and ASM-0041 are about what an ACKNOWLEDGED insert durably established; they are foreign, per mechanism, and unchanged. These theorems are about what happens when there is NO acknowledgement, and about the configuration that would silently invalidate the premise. Neither theorem is evidence for its premise and neither strengthens it. THE DEPENDENCY EDGE IS A GENUINE MISSING EDGE, found by asking top-down what the root requires rather than upward from the registry. THM-0092's security consequence is explicitly about a deployment that serves a replayed request as fresh because the store it was supposed to consult was unreachable. Its own battery measures that against a STUB store that errors; nothing measured that the DEPLOYED adapters error rather than returning Fresh. THM-0092 therefore now depends on THM-0106 and THM-0107, and the closure now includes results measured only in feature lanes — which is honest, because the root's claim about fleet-strict deployments genuinely rests on backends that exist only in those lanes. LANE IDENTITY IS PART OF THE EVIDENCE: a plain cargo test --workspace compiles both adapter files to zero tests, so each unit names its own test_features. verify-mutations has honoured test_features only since #822; before that fix every probe over these batteries would have returned MEASUREMENT FAILURE rather than a result. FORTY-TWO CONTROLS EXISTED ACROSS THE TWO ADAPTERS AND WERE NAMED BY NO UNIT, twenty of them here, so what they measured was evidence for nothing. THE CONJUNCT WORTH NAMING is that an UNREADABLE maxmemory-policy is refused, not only an evicting one. That is the guard on ASM-0040's own precondition: key-present is the whole replay signal, so an admitted nonce that leaves the keyspace before its TTL reads Fresh again for the rest of its freshness window, on every replica, silently, produced by capacity pressure rather than by an attack. Every replay key carries a PX TTL, which makes it a PREFERRED victim under volatile-* and an ordinary one under allkeys-*, so volatile-* is not the safer half. A deployment whose policy could not be asked is one whose premise cannot be checked, and an unverifiable policy is not evidence of a safe one. Probes M124 and M125 red-verified on this tree. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED, in the scope: nothing about durability, which is ASM-0040 with its documented failover caveat; not a liveness claim; and the policy is read ONCE, at connect, so a server reconfigured underneath a live connection is not detected and the theorem says so.
